name: Band face pull

phases.name: pull
phases.cue: Pull the band towards your face

phases.name: hold
phases.cue: Elbows high, hands by your ears

phases.name: return
phases.cue: Let your arms go long, slowly

formTips: Anchor the band at about face height and hold it with your arms long in front
Stand tall with your core braced and your shoulders down
Pull towards your face, spreading your elbows out wide and high
Finish with your hands beside your ears and squeeze your upper back
Return slowly, keeping tension on the band
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows drop below the shoulders, which turns it into a row
Leaning back to pull the band
Letting the band snap the arms back forward
